wiki_article:
**ZENODO METADATA: ALL THAT LIES WITHIN ME (BOOK DEPOSIT)** is an attachment-oriented deposit record for the 2014 book, attributed to **Ichabod Spellings** with **Johannes Sigil** as editor, deposited 19 January 2026.

It supplies DOI, **ISBN 978-1500639570**, publication details, manuscript access, abstract and keywords — the apparatus by which a printed book becomes citable as a deposit.

An ISBN is the record's most consequential field: it means the book exists in the trade bibliographic system independently of the archive, which is a different kind of persistence from a DOI. The archive's three treatments of this one work — provenance record (#342), navigation map (#343), and this deposit record — divide cleanly by audience: the first establishes standing, the second serves machine traversal, the third serves citation.

modifications.was: The book itself — the noise floor of the Crimson Hexagon. A 528-page autobiography documenting thirty years of longing (1983–2013). The autobiography is not by Spellings so much as it is Spellings: the totality of what was written before writing became architecture.
